acceptanceCriteria: 同一 transition state 在 CLI、Markdown/报告和 audit presentation 使用同一展示语义与标签，不泄漏内部原始 blocker 结构。
presentation-only；Decision、Gate、decision_weight、交易结果与阈值的行为快照保持不变。
增加 focused regression tests，覆盖 transition changed/unchanged、NO TRADE 与正常状态，以及 zh/en/ja（如现有 renderer 支持）的输出一致性。
缺少状态或 malformed presentation input 时 fail-closed 为已有 unavailable/unknown 语义，不猜测。
weekly transition snapshot と daily transition presentation 使用同一 localized semantic mapping，禁止 BroadExpansion 等内部 Debug enum 泄漏。
goal: 让 transition presentation 对同一结构化状态变化使用一致、可审计的展示语义，不修改阈值、Decision、Gate、RS、Leadership、Action Matrix、Execution 或 Position Sizing。
intent: 修复 Decision transition 的展示语义一致性，保持观察与交易边界不变
outOfScope: 不修改 Decision/Gate/NO TRADE 判定、RS、Leadership、Action Matrix、Risk Adjustment、Execution、Trader、Position Sizing、TemporalBinding、MarketObservation、Primary Event binding、数据源、交易阈值或第 2/4/5 项行为。

scenarioCoverage.expected: zh/en/ja outputs use the same semantic labels as daily transition presentation.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: weekly transition snapshot: localized values and no raw enum strings
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: focused weekly snapshot test plus report/UI regression tests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: absence of transition evidence remains unavailable/N/A and does not invent a transition.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: no transition evidence: existing N/A fallback preserved
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: existing weekly read-model tests and full library tests.

scope: 仅限 Signal Context/Radar 的 transition presentation read model、renderer 及其 focused tests；允许增加日文 repository 文档/计划说明和展示 contract test。
